name: Mirai Senki Slavenil
original_name: 未来戦姫スレイブニル
source:
This is STARGAZER’s debut title. Katana had a dream one day: he was the ultimate ruler on a giant battleship floating in space, meeting his loyal and admiring subjects. This moment of unspeakable bliss was shattered by a sharp pain in his chest. He saw blood when he put his hand to his chest and wondered if he was going to die. Even though he knew it was a dream, he felt extreme loss and sadness as he fell… into the arms of a naked girl. She told him that even though this was just a dream, it could happen at a later time and that she would protect him.

Katana woke up confused and found the same naked girl in front of him. She introduced herself as EXE, a war maiden called ‘slavenil’, sent to protect him… or at least get his genes if she failed to do so. Four other girls later appeared, also after his life or genes. They were the space pirate Yuraha, the princess of a fallen kingdom Tsukino, the assassin Nao, and another slavenil EXA. In the middle of the fierce fight among them, it happened that they all moved in with him. What will happen to Kanata and these five girls?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是STARGAZER的首部作品。某天，卡塔纳做了一个梦：他是漂浮在宇宙中的巨大战舰上的最高统治者，正与忠诚而仰慕他的臣民会面。这份难以言喻的幸福，却被胸口传来的剧痛打破。他将手按在胸前，看见了鲜血，不禁怀疑自己是否就要死去。即使知道这是梦，他仍在跌落时感到无比的失落与悲伤…随后落入一名裸体女孩的怀中。女孩告诉他，虽然这只是梦，却可能在未来成为现实，而她会保护他。

卡塔纳困惑地醒来，发现梦中那个裸体女孩就站在面前。她自称EXE，是一名被称为“斯莱布尼尔”的战姬，受派遣前来保护他…或者，在保护失败时，至少取得他的基因。后来，又有四名女孩出现，同样为他的性命或基因而来。她们分别是宇宙海盗尤拉哈、亡国公主月乃、刺客娜奥，以及另一名斯莱布尼尔EXA。在她们激烈的争斗之中，事情却发展成所有人都搬来与他同住。卡塔纳与这五名女孩，究竟会迎来怎样的生活？

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
